blutbad.name: Blutbad
blutbad.desc: Wolf-blooded Wesen. The reformed are quiet folk. The rogues hunt by moonlight, kill in frenzy.
blutbad.signs: Coarse grey fur, silver-tipped in mature beasts. Broad paw-prints with too-wide splay. Throat-tearing kills, ragged not clean. Howls before the strike.
blutbad.weakness: Wolfsbane drives them mad and weak.

fuchsbau.name: Fuchsbau
fuchsbau.desc: Fox-kin. Cunning, oft thieves and merchants. Rarely kill — but cornered, lethal.
fuchsbau.signs: Russet fur, fine and short. Small, dainty tracks. Surgical claw-cuts, narrow. Theft accompanies killing — cellar, larder, coin-purse. Vanishing tricks.
fuchsbau.weakness: Salt across a doorway holds them.

jagerbar.name: Jägerbar
jagerbar.desc: Bear-blooded. Vast and slow to anger.
jagerbar.signs: Coarse brown shag, matted with oil. Pawprints the breadth of a dinner plate. Crushed bones, splintered timbers. Wide gouges from claws like sickles. No fang-marks — the kill is by crushing.
jagerbar.weakness: Pitch matted in their fur seizes their claws.

skalengeck.name: Skalengeck
skalengeck.signs: Greenish scales shed in patches. Curving belly-drag in mud. Puncture-bites, twin holes at the throat, with venom.
skalengeck.weakness: Fire and torchlight chill the cold blood to torpor.

spinnetod.name: Spinnetod
spinnetod.desc: Spider-kin. The female must feed on a man's vitality every few years to halt rapid aging. In human form she is impossibly beautiful. By the time a man suspects, he has already been chosen.
spinnetod.signs: Grey-black hair, distinctive and long. Two hollow fang-marks 4mm apart on the neck. Victims found serene, organs dissolved from within. She always takes a trophy — something shining from her victim.
spinnetod.weakness: Do not let her climb. She is faster on a vertical surface. Her limbs regenerate if severed — strike the body.

lausenschlange.name: Lausenschlange
lausenschlange.desc: Boa-kin. They do not chase. They wait in the dark where their prey will come, and they are patient beyond what patience should mean in a living thing.
lausenschlange.signs: Constriction without bruising — force distributed evenly across all ribs. A sinuous 40cm-wide trail in dust. Iridescent shed scales. Drainage gaps widened recently. Ancient instinct for rodent-kin Wesen.
lausenschlange.weakness: The spine and skull are weak points. Their grip, once applied, cannot be broken without a blade — avoid grapple range.

hexenbiest.name: Hexenbiest
hexenbiest.desc: Witch-Beast. Near-Grimm strength AND telekinesis, fire, and compulsion. The most unpredictable Wesen encountered. Their kills leave no physical trace unless you know what to look for.
hexenbiest.signs: Unnatural cold in the body — frozen from within. Burnt copper smell of Zaubertrank. The biest mark — a dark U-shape under the tongue — present in all Hexenbiester, living and dead.
hexenbiest.weakness: Grimm blood causes immediate and permanent power loss. A Hexenbiest who ingests it becomes fully human. This does not make them less dangerous in the moment.

skalenzahne.name: Skalenzähne
skalenzahne.desc: Crocodile-kin. They live peacefully until they taste human or Wesen flesh. The first taste triggers an addiction near-impossible to break — the flesh hunger overrides all other drives.
skalenzahne.signs: Bite radius 34cm — consistent with a large crocodilian. Serrated tooth impressions in bone. Two-phase wounds: controlled initial strike, then frenzied feeding. Chitinous scutes shed at the scene.
skalenzahne.weakness: Thick hide reduces damage on the sides and back. Aim for the underbelly during the recovery window after a lunge.

ziegevolk.name: Ziegevolk
ziegevolk.desc: Goat-Folk. No physical threat. Their power is entirely pheromonal — complete emotional compliance in anyone exposed. Victims are not confused; they are happy.
ziegevolk.signs: All missing persons last seen smiling, following willingly. Musky-sweet smell near the suspect. Money withdrawn freely. Victims recall feeling deeply at peace — and want to return.
ziegevolk.weakness: Cover the nose. Move fast. The Ziegevolk itself is physically weak — reach it before the pheromones do their work. Extended exposure dulls even a Grimm.

coyotl.name: Coyotl
coyotl.desc: Coyote-kin. Pack hunters with strong clan structure. Outside ritual they are often peaceable family units. Interrupting the Aseveracion creates a blood feud with the entire clan.
coyotl.signs: Coordinated pack attack — multiple distinct claw patterns, flanking formation. Carved ritual tokens bearing a crescent and claw motif. Canine musk. Ritual site with candle wax and disturbed earth.
coyotl.weakness: A negotiation path exists if the clan mother's testimony is in hand. Blood feud risk if the family is killed rather than reasoned with.

klaustreich.name: Klaustreich
klaustreich.desc: Alley-cat kin. Charming to those they consider worth charming. Predatory toward those beneath them — Reinigen are their traditional prey, hunted for sport.
klaustreich.signs: Feline claw geometry — four-point grip, feline spacing. Coarse non-domestic cat hair. Uses walls and ceiling as readily as floor. Scratch marks high on door frames.
klaustreich.weakness: Vertical movement is their advantage. Force them to the ground or a confined flat space and the speed advantage collapses.

cracher_mortel.name: Cracher-Mortel
cracher_mortel.desc: Puffer-fish kin. Their saliva contains tetrodotoxin that induces complete physical paralysis while leaving the mind intact. The victim is aware of their own burial.
cracher_mortel.signs: Grave opened from outside — hinges bent outward. Blue-grey spittle residue on the victim. Tetrodotoxin presentation: sudden painless collapse, breathing undetectable. Victim later seen walking, vacant-eyed.
cracher_mortel.weakness: A reversal agent exists — it must be administered before the rage state begins on day four. Find the victim before then.

gevatter_tod.name: Gevatter Tod
gevatter_tod.desc: Assassin-bug kin. Professional killers — not frenzied, not compelled, not addicted. They choose this. Their biology produces a toxin deliverable through a hollow appendage between the fingers.
gevatter_tod.signs: Microscopic puncture wound at the back of the neck. Biological toxin, death in under two minutes. A single black wing-case fragment is the only physical trace they ever leave — and only when rushed.
gevatter_tod.weakness: You will not catch a Gevatter Tod at the scene. Follow the money to whoever hired them. Then choose: the hired hand, or the one who gave the order.
